approvalTitle: Conflict Service Enhanced - Tasks Document Approval
content:
# Tasks Document

  - Purpose: Establish data structures for conflict detection system
  - _Leverage: internal/models/models.go, gorm.io/gorm_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.3, 1.7_
  - _Prompt: Role: Go Developer specializing in data modeling and GORM | Task: Create comprehensive data models for conflict detection system following requirements 1.1, 1.3, and 1.7, extending patterns from internal/models/models.go with proper GORM tags and validation | Restrictions: Must follow existing model patterns, do not modify existing models, maintain proper database relationship design | Success: All models compile without errors, proper GORM relationships defined, validation rules implemented, database migrations can be generated successfully_
